name: Serap Şahin
bio:
Serap Şahin was born in 1982 in Izmir’s Tire district. After graduating from Burdur Anatolia Teacher’s High School in 2000, she graduated from the Department of English Language Teaching at Atatürk University Faculty of Education. During her university years, she introduced Erzurum and its disadvantaged rural districts to theatre and books with the Education Volunteers Student Club, which she founded.

She has worked as an English teacher in Antalya since 2005. She is the author of Beyazlar Ülkesinin Kahramanları (Heroes of the Land of Whites), Cesur Tohum Pino (Brave Seed Pino), Orf Vadisi (Orf Valley) and Saklı Boyut (Hidden Dimension). In 2018, she launched the Düş Bavulu (Dream Suitcase) project, which she continues to lead, bringing together many narrative languages and stories with children. Using the P4C technique, she runs question-based work with children, discovering new associations as she questions.
